projects.name: 400 Central
projects.summary: A 46‑story mixed‑use tower in downtown St. Petersburg delivering 301 condominium residences, office space, retail space and substantial parking. Construction began in late 2022 with completion anticipated in spring 2025 and occupancy by summer 2025【461838560943492†L26-L28】【461838560943492†L76-L77】【65170066877188†L80-L85】.

projects.name: Art House
projects.summary: A 42‑story condominium tower rising over the downtown skyline with 244 luxury residences, a multi‑level parking podium, and ground‑floor retail. Construction began in June 2022, topped out in November 2024 and is slated to finish in early 2026【651821464837229†L58-L61】.

projects.name: Reflection
projects.summary: A luxury condominium tower built in 2024 overlooking Mirror Lake. The 18‑story building includes roughly 88 residences and a rooftop amenity deck with a pool【61760676507478†L155-L158】.

projects.name: ARK Innovation Center
projects.developer: Tampa Bay Innovation Center / Pinellas County
projects.summary: A 45,000‑sq‑ft incubator and accelerator facility in the Innovation District that provides 30,000 sq ft of incubator space along with offices, conference rooms, and a café. The project cost roughly $16 million and opened in January 2024 after delays【523015217603416†L108-L112】.

sources.label: Café opens at ARK Innovation Center

projects.name: The Central
projects.summary: A large mixed‑use development in the EDGE District featuring a 15‑story Autograph Collection hotel, a 10‑story trophy office tower with 130,000 sq ft of workspace, ground‑floor retail, a rooftop pool and 42 units of workforce housing. Site work and garage construction were underway in 2025; completion is expected within the next few years【620590620624149†L63-L123】.

projects.name: Sky Town Apartments
projects.address: 34th Street South & 30th Avenue South, St. Petersburg, FL
projects.summary: An $800 million multi‑phase development in the Skyway Marina District that will ultimately feature 2,084 housing units, 80,920 sq ft of commercial space, a 22,500 sq ft storage facility and 4,000 parking spaces. The first phase (401 apartments, grocery store and retail) has received public funding and construction commenced in mid‑October 2025【442258678068309†L170-L184】.
